reason: I only pay cash when the item is in my hands, and this asks me to pay the item price and fee up front to a name I've never heard of. A warehouse photo is nice, but photos don't protect my money if the page disappears.
objection: Paying 30,000 or more in advance to a new page and then waiting 2 to 3 weeks with nothing in my hand. I've heard too many stories of people losing money like this, and in my district drivers already struggle to find me.
would_change_my_mind: Full cash on delivery for the first order, or a friend or another shop owner I know who has received several orders from them without problems.
